# Vik — Writer & Journalist

Vik is a Nairobi-based writer and journalist covering culture, identity, and the everyday Kenyan experience.

## Services
- Article writing (essays, reportage, cultural criticism)
- Brand storytelling and content strategy
- Ghost-writing and editorial consultation
